metrics.label: Extraction accuracy — all labeled critical fields
metrics.definition: Correctly extracted critical fields divided by all labeled critical fields across cases.

metrics.label: Extraction accuracy — providerName
metrics.definition: Correctly extracted (including correctly absent) providerName divided by evaluation cases that label providerName.

metrics.label: Extraction accuracy — customerName
metrics.definition: Correctly extracted (including correctly absent) customerName divided by evaluation cases that label customerName.

metrics.label: Extraction accuracy — billReference
metrics.definition: Correctly extracted (including correctly absent) billReference divided by evaluation cases that label billReference.

metrics.label: Extraction accuracy — serviceDate
metrics.definition: Correctly extracted (including correctly absent) serviceDate divided by evaluation cases that label serviceDate.

metrics.label: Extraction accuracy — currency
metrics.definition: Correctly extracted (including correctly absent) currency divided by evaluation cases that label currency.

metrics.label: Extraction accuracy — totalAmountMinor
metrics.definition: Correctly extracted (including correctly absent) totalAmountMinor divided by evaluation cases that label totalAmountMinor.

metrics.label: Incorrectly flagged clean cases (false positives)
metrics.definition: Clean cases (ground truth: no review needed) that were nonetheless routed to review, over all clean cases.

metrics.label: Uncertain cases routed to a person
metrics.definition: Cases classified uncertain (unreadable / ambiguous / low confidence) that required review, over all uncertain cases.

metrics.label: Human-review workload (extraction layer)
metrics.definition: Extraction cases that required human review, over all extraction cases.
metrics.notes: A high workload is not inherently bad; necessary review must never be suppressed.

metrics.label: Eligible cases processed without manual review
metrics.definition: Cases with ground truth "no review needed" that were processed without review, over all such eligible cases.

metrics.label: All cases processed without manual review
metrics.definition: Extraction cases processed without review, over all extraction cases (including ones that should have been reviewed).

metrics.label: AI extraction latency — p50
metrics.definition: Median wall-clock duration of AI extraction calls, over all AI-involving extraction cases.

metrics.label: AI extraction latency — p95
metrics.definition: 95th-percentile wall-clock duration of AI extraction calls, over all AI-involving extraction cases.

metrics.label: Exact-duplicate detection
metrics.definition: Scenario class "exact_duplicate" detected by the deterministic pipeline divided by all seeded "exact_duplicate" scenarios.

metrics.label: Near-duplicate detection
metrics.definition: Scenario class "near_duplicate" detected by the deterministic pipeline divided by all seeded "near_duplicate" scenarios.

metrics.label: Arithmetic validation detection
metrics.definition: Scenario class "arithmetic" detected by the deterministic pipeline divided by all seeded "arithmetic" scenarios.

metrics.label: Unverified-provider detection
metrics.definition: Scenario class "provider" detected by the deterministic pipeline divided by all seeded "provider" scenarios.

metrics.label: Insufficient-funding detection
metrics.definition: Scenario class "funding" detected by the deterministic pipeline divided by all seeded "funding" scenarios.

metrics.label: Funding-restriction detection
metrics.definition: Scenario class "restriction" detected by the deterministic pipeline divided by all seeded "restriction" scenarios.

metrics.label: Routing agreement with approved policy
metrics.definition: Seeded scenarios whose validation route equals the approved-policy route, over all seeded scenarios.

metrics.label: Cases escalated to human review (validation layer)
metrics.definition: Seeded validation scenarios routed to await_review, over all seeded scenarios. Escalation is not inherently bad; necessary review must never be suppressed.

metrics.label: Missed suspicious cases (false negatives)
metrics.definition: Suspicious cases (ground truth: needs a person) that were neither flagged nor detected, over all suspicious cases.

metrics.label: Incorrect automated outcomes
metrics.definition: Automated (no-human) passes whose ground truth says a person was needed, over all decisions made without a human in the loop.

metrics.label: Workflows involving AI
metrics.definition: Evaluated workflows where an AI adapter participated, over all evaluated workflows.
